Bobby Flay's friends Damaris Phillips and Michael Symon get together for the very first time to try to take their pal down; he'll have to tango with fellow New Yorkers Andrew Lukovsky and Airis Johnson, who aren't going down without a fight.

Reid Scott makes a campaign run against Bobby Flay with all-star running mate Sunny Anderson; chefs Ned Baldwin and Sieger Bayer want to veto Bobby's winning record and snag a landslide victory of their own.

title: The Great Food Truck Race
description:
S18 E07 — Truckin' Awesome: Bad News in Newport News
The final three trucks undergo Tyler Florence's secret surveillance challenge in Newport News, VA, and the loser gets shut down for an hour; the top teams blow challenges they could have easily won; one truck sets an all-time sales record.

title: The Great Food Truck Race
description:
S18 E08 — Truckin' Awesome: Norfolk Fork-off
Tyler Florence challenges the final two teams to feed the sailors of an aircraft carrier at Naval Station Norfolk; the trucks move to town, and it all comes down to sales.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S02 E01 — The House Duels
James and Oliver Phelps assign eight pairs of pastry wizards into the four Hogwarts Houses and ask them to create a showpiece with at least one tasting element; Judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef decide which bakers move on to the next challenge.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S02 E02 — Wizard's Journey
In front of the Knight Bus, James and Oliver Phelps ask the remaining six teams to make transportation-inspired showpieces that incorporate classic English desserts; guest Devon Murray joins Judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S02 E03 — The Edible Artifacts
Inspired by Polyjuice Potion, James and Oliver Phelps challenge the five remaining teams to recreate two items as hyperrealistic edible showpieces; judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef decide which team made the most convincing and delicious artifact.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S02 E04 — Up to No Good
Hosts James and Oliver Phelps challenge the baking teams to create supersized "Harry Potter" artifacts that reveal something from within; special guest Afshan Azad joins judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S02 E05 — Magical Beasts, Beings, and Creatures
James and Oliver Phelps ask the remaining four baking teams to create showpieces that bring a Harry Potter creature to life, along with a bold smoky or spicy tasting element; special guest Warwick Davis joins judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S02 E06 — The Goblet of Fire
For the finale in the Great Hall, James and Oliver Phelps ask the bakers to create showpieces celebrating the Goblet of Fire; guest judges Warwick Davis, Afshan Azad and Devon Murray join Carla Hall to award the Wizards of Baking trophy.

title: Chopped
description:
S60 E09 — Zhoug-topia
Competitors race to turn mystery ingredients into three-course meals; it's all about skill, speed and ingenuity and only one chef will impress the judges enough to survive the chopping block.

title: Chopped
description:
S63 E10 — Seoul Searching
In the first round, four chefs with a deep love for Korean food get creative with a canned fish and a citrus compote; two popular Korean proteins are part of the puzzle in the entrée round.

title: Chopped
description:
S64 E02 — Ted's Takeover
Ted is in charge of the baskets; in the first round, he challenges the chefs with a wildly unusual product in a tube and his favorite snack of all time; the final basket includes an exotic extract and an Italian dessert that Ted can never pass up.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S29 E14 — Bobby, Why Don't You Just Meet Me at the Griddle?
Country music superstar Maren Morris teams up with Sunny Anderson to sing Bobby Flay's swan song; chefs Matthew Dolan and Thomas Kelly give everyone something to taco 'bout.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S30 E11 — Smoove Operator
Damaris Phillips and actor JB Smoove are ready to get in Bobby Flay's face; they get help from chefs Christian Gill and Cecelia Valencia, who want to sandwich Bobby out of the kitchen.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S33 E04 — MMMMBibimbap
Tiffany Derry and Jet Tila join forces with chefs Chrissy Camba and Johnny Clark to wipe Bobby Flay off the map.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S30 E15 — Alex, Eric & America vs Bobby
Chef Alex Guarnaschelli reunites with her "Alex vs America" host, chef Eric Adjepong, to lead the charge for chefs Tomas Chavarria and Tara Monsod to take Bobby Flay down a peg.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S05 E02 — Titans vs. Bao Bao
The Noodle Queen, Suchanan Chef Bao Bao Aksornnan, is ready to settle a score with Bobby Flay that's 10 years in the making; she's using her arsenal of Thai flavors to impress judge Viet Pham, who has beaten the Titans, and even Bobby, twice.

title: Kitchen Undercover
description:
S01 E06 — Ay Mami
Mami Mosas serves up big brunch vibes but is bleeding money. After Chef Lofaso and her sous-chef Nestor Milian uncover untrained cooks, a filthy kitchen and roaches, it's a race to turn things around before the Health Department shuts them down.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S04 E01 — Titans vs. Nini Nguyen
Bobby Flay isn't taking it easy on the new Titan, Ayesha Nurdjaja, as he invites the winner of "Last Bite Hotel," chef Nini Nguyen, to challenge the Titans; judge Daniel Boulud keeps the pressure high with his palate.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S04 E08 — Titans vs Adrianne Calvo
Miami chef Adrianne Calvo won SOBE Food and Wine Festival's Triple Threat competition, but can she take down Bobby Flay's Titans on their home turf to win $25,000? OG restaurateur Rick Bayless amps up the pressure with his judging.

description:

Hosts and judges Duff Goldman and Kardea Brown put 12 sibling teams through two rounds of skills challenges to assess which 10 teams will move on; the teams make their best cupcake and must create a pie from scratch.

description:
S01 E02 — Family Favorite
Duff Goldman and Kardea Brown task the sibling teams with creating family favorite desserts, but there's a five-minute baking time extension at stake that puts the bakers into a spin.

description:

Three top chefs from Northern California's wine country compete to show off their vintage; Guy Fieri welcomes them to the market with a gift basket full of local artisanal goods that they must feature in their signature dish.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S32 E03 — Super Seafood Showdown
Four seafood masters play Go Fish to determine what they'll cook for dinner, and they make a shellfish feast using sample items from the store.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S33 E03 — Sweet Deception All-Stars
Guy Fieri surprises three of his all-star friends by turning a savory showdown into a dessert battle; they'll have to transform diner classics into sweet treats before making a fried dessert using mystery ingredients from Crazy Can Roulette.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S35 E10 — DDD Seafood
Guy Fieri invites four favorite Diners, Drive-ins and Dives seafood chefs to make some waves in Flavortown Market; they create a regional fish dish using the catch in their fly-fishing net and dig for canned seafood to feature in a shellfish dish.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S33 E10 — Winner, Winner, One Big Dinner
Four GGG winners return to Guy Fieri's Flavortown for a chance to take another crown in one big round; they must make a winner's dinner complete with an appetizer and entrée in an hourlong battle to shop the market for up to $20,000.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
All-Star Grocery Rush-a-Thon
Four of the food world's fastest chefs compete in Guy Fieri's quickest game, Grocery Rush; they must create an upscale dinner in just 20 minutes before the bouncing balls select the mandatory protein.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S39 E01 — Guy's Favorites
Three of Guy Fieri's favorite DDD chefs and three GGG winners compete in a tag-team relay to create a pork dinner; the first shift chef shops for a favorite snack food and piece of equipment selected by a roll of the old culinary dice.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S40 E01 — Beat the Judges: Non-Stop Noodles
Guy Fieri welcomes three chefs who won in the past to take on each other in a non-stop noodle event; the winner gets a shot at turning their prize money into $20,000 if they can beat a GGG judge in a noodle cook-off.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S42 E12 — Food Fanatic Teams
Fieri invites three foodies with big online followings to team up with their favorite all-star chefs in a high-energy competition. The teams must prove they're masters of digital communication by planning a classic food duo over their smartphones.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description: Guy Fieri pits four talented chefs against each other in three elimination challenges that put their culinary skills to the test as they compete for a cash prize.

Guy Fieri challenges three chefs with one five-minute shop for the whole competition; they can only grab two ingredients per aisle to make a family friendly brunch; they must make an upscale dinner using leftover ingredients.

description:
S07 E06 — Flay v. Chauhan v. Williamson -- Capital City 'Cue
Inspired by the live music scene in Austin, Texas, and led by team captains Bobby Flay, Maneet Chauhan and Brooke Williamson, the Brawlers must listen closely and hit all the right notes with their BBQ feasts.

title: BBQ Brawl
description:
S07 E07 — Flay V. Chauhan V. Williamson - Primal BBQ
The grills and smokers are gone, and the Brawlers must go back to basics with raw wood, stone and salt blocks; team captains Bobby Flay, Maneet Chauhan and Brooke Williamson lead the competitors in their toughest team brawl yet.

title: BBQ Brawl
description:
S07 E08 — Flay V. Chauhan V. Williamson - Stars, Strips, and Smoke
It's America's 250th birthday and, for the first time, the Brawlers compete as individuals to win over a hungry crowd.

title: Chopped
description:
S58 E09 — Breakfast Baskets!
Inspired by hash browns and energized by eggs, four chefs wake up the judges' palates using baskets packed with breakfast foods; two chefs battle with breakfast sandwiches as entrées, while a strange coffee and meat dish prove challenging.

title: Chopped
description:
S58 E12 — Abalone Absurdities
The chefs are shocked when abalone appears in their appetizer baskets; a fusion soup and a colorful veggie are in the entrée basket, and an unwelcome egg is in the dessert basket.

title: Chopped
description:
S64 E08 — Leftovers Gone Wild!
In the appetizer round, the chefs show that they have what it takes to transform leftovers into a meal; in the entrée round, the competitors attempt to impress the judges using a variety of tools and techniques.

description:

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S03 E09 — Titans vs. Ashleigh Shanti
Bobby Flay invites rising star Chef Ashleigh Shanti to face-off against the Titans; she keeps the Titans guessing with her unique mix of Appalachian and Southern cooking, while Chef Wylie Dufresne doles out his criticisms.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S03 E06 — Titans vs. Ayaka Guido
Bobby Flay challenges the Titans with Chef Ayaka Guido, and as the right hand to Chef Jean-Georges Vongerichten, she comes prepared with her Michelin training; the Titans are shocked by the return of Chef Frank Prisinzano and his bold opinions.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S28 E15 — It's All Business
Chefs and business partners Scott Calhoun and David Feola must challenge each other before they take Bobby Flay down; Anne Burrell and Michael Symon give Bobby the business.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S30 E06 — Don't Oaxacaway From Me
Chefs Noah Zamler and Aerin Zavory are here to make sure Bobby Flay doesn't walk away with the competition; they've got Geoffrey Zakarian and Brooke Williamson on their team to pummel Bobby with pranks.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S31 E03 — New Phone, Who Dis?
Katie Lee Biegel and David Burtka dial up the distractions while chefs Lambert Givens and Jesse Houston try to ring Bobby Flay's bell.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S33 E12 — Shock, Awe and Shakshuka
Chef Michael Voltaggio and actress Ellie Kemper bring the pain as chefs Travis McGinty and Suzanne Vizethann crack more than a few eggs in their quest to take down Bobby Flay.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S36 E07 — Loud and Proud
Chef Antonia Lofaso partners with comedian Leslie Jones to bring the nuttiness, as chefs Josh Elliot and Vicky Colas attempt to get the last laugh over Bobby Flay.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S35 E14 — Anchors Aweigh
Eddie Jackson and Poppy Harlow break the news to Bobby Flay that he is going to lose; Chefs Dayna Lee and Enrique Lozano hope to flatten the competition.

description:
S37 E04 — Celebrate Good Times!
Maneet Chauhan and Jaymee Sire celebrate Bobby Flay's demise and invite chefs Victoria Elizondo and Tajahi Cooke to join their party!

description:
S40 E07 — This Is How We Roll
Bobby Flay is way out of his element with a signature dish he's never made before; Damaris Phillips and Christian Petroni taunt him as chefs Ilji Cheung and Pyet Despain attempt to roll up a win.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S41 E04 — School That Fool
Abbott Elementary's Quinta Brunson and Chef Michael Voltaggio try to give Bobby Flay detention with their star pupils, chefs Devan Cunningham and Justin Jacobs.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S41 E14 — Tough as Nails
Powerhouse chefs Antonia Lofaso and Ayesha Nurdjaja recruit competitors Pete Amadhanirundr and Evelyn Garcia for a fierce showdown against Bobby Flay.

Host Noah Cappe samples Southern hospitality on fairgrounds across the county; the carnival treats he finds are all infused with a down-home goodness that makes each bite taste like Southern sugar and spice.

description: Join Cindy Crawford as she talks to real customers about the breakthrough skincare system that keeps them looking their best. Take a trip to the stunning French countryside to see the rare French melon that defies the aging process.

title: Tournament of Champions
description:
S05 E05 — The Super 16 Step Up
Guy Fieri gathers some of the world's greatest chefs for an intense, single-elimination culinary tournament; emotions run high as the chefs battle to stay in the competition, and surprises unfold both inside and outside the arena.

title: The Great Food Truck Race
description:
S19 E05 — Sweet & Savory: Dishing It Out at Dollywood
The remaining four teams take on massive crowds and amusement park chaos at Dollywood in Pigeon Forge, TN. Guest judge Arnold Myint joins Tyler Florence for a potato-focused redemption battle and an emotional elimination.

title: The Great Food Truck Race
description:
S19 E06 — Sweet & Savory: The Great Kentucky Cook-Off
In Louisville, Ky., Tyler Florence gives the final three teams a taste challenge featuring the state fruit, the blackberry; in the last redemption battle, guest judge Kelsey Murphy tasks teams with creating a dish centered around beer cheese.
